title: Malformed short options emit extra replacement characters
prompt: On Unix, malformed non-UTF-8 bytes in grouped short options produce too many replacement-character options. For the raw argument bytes [45, 240, 157, 97], parsing should yield Short('�') followed by Short('a'); the incomplete argument [45, 240, 157] should yield just Short('�'). Keep valid Unicode, separate invalid sequences, subsequent options, and raw option values intact. Fix the inconsistency and add regression coverage.
regression_provenance: Upstream commit adds test_lossy_decode plus byte-boundary assertions and updates the changelog.

setup.solver_export: Only source at base_commit, public prompt, baseline lockfile, and tool environment; exclude repository history, oracle, hidden tests, and MinifyCLI evaluator files.
setup.baseline_lockfile: Copy assets.baseline_lockfile to the exported source root as Cargo.lock before warming or exposing the solver workspace.
setup.cargo_target_dir: Use a distinct target directory for every exported root, including oracle and solver variants. Do not reuse a target directory across copied roots.
